report:
Reviewed the complete claim, sole ordinary evidence.rs association, all four ordinary tests and the explicit TODO test. Verified historical comparison personally: both associated test files are byte-identical; evidence.rs differs only by addition of the meta.reviews.decisions marker above placeholder_status. This does not change reference parsing. Reassessed current source and assertions rather than adopting the old verdict.

index_source accepts ordinary line-comment markers with exact backtick syntax and either empty suffix or immediately adjacent <<; marker delegates name grammar to the captured valid_anchor_name helper. Malformed names/suffixes produce diagnostics. line_comments skips tokenized literals (including grouped macro tokens), nested block comments and documentation comments; Lines preserves Unicode-aware byte spans and line locations. Scope selection retains enclosing modules and inherited context; each entry is pushed into its name's vector, preserving repeated references. The captured spec helper separately diagnoses every unknown name at its annotation location; integration adequacy for this part remains deferred below.

malformed_reference_names_and_suffixes_are_errors visibly checks nine malformed examples for no entries and one relevant diagnostic. only_actual_line_comments_declare_implementation_entries includes ordinary/raw/byte/C/raw-C/escaped strings, character and nested-block/doc text, shebang and macro input; it checks exactly the two real references, file/module, line 17 and exact annotation span. repeated_references_keep_distinct_crates_and_targets asserts three distinct retained sites across two crates/targets and different spans for repeated sites in one file. cargo_owned_out_of_line_sources_retain_inherited_module_and_cfg exercises Cargo loading, rejects an unowned file by checking only one entry, and checks inherited module, source file, cfg, TODO status and excerpt. Captured the small index fixture helper used by the tests. These assertions would detect literal false positives, malformed acceptance, reference deduplication and lost module/location context.

The empty todo::rust_implementation_references test explicitly defers resolving real comments across crates and rejecting malformed/dangling references while excluding string contents. Much of that broad TODO now has substantive ordinary coverage; its remaining justified prerequisite is an anchor-associated end-to-end specification-resolution fixture/assertions proving dangling-reference rejection (and positive resolution), rather than merely syntax extraction. Optional region syntax is supported directly by marker/index_source; stronger integrated reference-resolution/region coverage remains within this visible deferred work. The TODO is not an executed proof or a claim of complete coverage. No N/A entries exist. No source changes or behavioral failures were identified.

Execution: personally ran review start/read and exact historical comparisons; no functional tests or cargo build were run by this reviewer. Coordinator's reported 321 passing sage-meta tests and root build are separate baseline execution, not independently reproduced here. Accepted with explicit TODO still deferred; no requested edits.
